module: Free camera (free flight, global camera of the 'world' group, hidden, order 10). Position and rotation are driven by MoveManager (translation right/left/forward/backward/up/down + absolute axes, rotation yaw/pitch/roll) with optional 'Newtonian' physics (force, mass, drag) for translation and rotation; a smoothed mode (setSmoothedCam(true), used by smoothFree) is softer. Optional planar translation mode that follows the terrain height (core_terrain). A manualzoom (FOV 65 by default) handles zoom. Returns a constructor.
usage:
local cam = core_camera.getCameraDataById ... -- or directly:
local free = require('core/cameraModes/free')()
free:setPosition(vec3(0, 0, 100))
free:setRotation(quatFromDir(vec3(0, 1, 0)))
free:setFOV(70)
notes: Translation speed: ((speed^2)/30)/40 (speed = the context's data.speed, tripled with data.fastSpeedModifier); without Newtonian physics the speed is this value * 15 m/s.
Default non-smoothed parameters: angularForce 400, angularDrag 16, mass 1, translationForce 250, translationDrag 17; smoothed: 150, 2.5, 10, 600, 2.
self.rot is a vec3 (yaw, pitch, roll in radians), pitch limited to ±1.5706. setRotation inverts the sign of y (YXZ conversion).
The extracted page says setPlanarTranslationInput(active) but the code is setPlanarTranslationInput(velocity, active).

C.desc: Free camera mode. Fields: pos (vec3), rot (vec3 radians), velocity, angularVelocity, planarVelocity, manualzoom, smoothed, newtonTranslation, newtonRotation, planarTranslation (and planarTranslationScale/Drag/Response/SpeedMultiplier for the planar mode), group = 'world', groupOrder.

init.desc: Sets the default values (isGlobal, group, hidden, canUseVehicleTriggerCrosshair, non-smoothed physics) then reset.

reset.desc: Cancels velocities and roll, recreates the manual zoom at 65 degrees.

setSmoothedCam.desc: Chooses the physics parameter set (smoothed or non-smoothed).

smoothed.desc: true for the smoothed cinematic mode

setPosition.desc: Sets the camera position (the table is kept by reference).

setRotation.desc: Sets the orientation from a quaternion.

setFOV.desc: Resets the manual zoom with this FOV.

listParams.desc: Settings exposed to the camera control UI / video stream: speed (2-100 m/s, read via core_camera.getSpeed), smooth, newtonRot, newtonTrans, fov (10-140).

setParam.desc: Changes a listParams setting (speed goes through core_camera.setSpeed).

clearMotion.desc: Cancels the translation, planar and angular velocities.

setPlanarTranslationInput.desc: Provides an external planar velocity (for example from a gamepad) for the frame; cleared after each update.

active.desc: true to apply it (otherwise reset to zero)

clearPlanarTranslationMotion.desc: Cancels the planar velocity and the external planar input.

onCameraChanged.desc: Hook: on focus gain, calls reset.

focused.desc: true if the mode takes focus

update.desc: Integrates rotation and translation from MoveManager and writes data.res.pos / rot, then applies the zoom.
